rules.rationale: This is the left-empty defining equation for the newly introduced structural predicate sameIntLists; it defines the result by requiring the right sequence to be empty and does not assert a separate mathematical fact or execute the program.
This is the structural mismatch equation of the newly introduced sameIntLists predicate, defining a nonempty left sequence paired with an empty right sequence as false.

This is the recursive constructor equation defining sameIntLists on two nonempty sequences; its head constraints and recursive tail call constitute the predicate's definition, and recursion descends on both tails.
This is the base equation for the newly introduced accumulator summary compareAcc, defining two exhausted input tails to return the accumulated sequence.

This is the recursive equation defining compareAcc: it appends the fixed-semantics term for the current absolute difference and recurs on both tails, thereby defining the named output summary rather than adding an independent lemma.
